correctness.rationale: With simultaneous independent recipient-side updates on K_(a,2), seed in the 2-vertex side, freeze the other hub and assign iid Geom(1/2) clocks to large-side vertices. Conditional hub survival through t rounds is product_{s=0}^{t-1} W_s/a; an equality-pattern set partition yields the stated exact finite-a formula. LLN and dominated convergence give P(G>t)=2^{-t(t-1)/2}; uniform tail bound P(G_a>t)<=2^{-(t-1)} proves mean convergence. Once both hubs blue, all remaining large vertices fill next round with probability approaching 1, giving Tsmall=>1+G and E→3.64163256.... Opposite large-side start waits Geom(2/a-1/a²) for any hub, followed by O(log a) expected completion; hence Tlarge/a=>Exp(2), E/a→1/2 with stated sandwich bound. Independent exact transition checks for 70 finite-state steps and P(G_a>3)=(a+1)/(8a) corroborate, do not prove, limits.
residual_risks: Only bidirected unweighted K_(a,2), one seed and a→∞; not the distinct sender-side probabilistic forcing model.

limitations: Finite checks do not prove weak convergence, which follows by frozen-process coupling, uniform summable tails and geometric scaling.
